name: NIWF World Championship
epitaph: Held by Todd Lucchesi (5-0) as of the fed's own 17 May 1998 rankings sheet, the promotion's own top singles title in its May-June record.

name: NIWF North American Championship
epitaph: Held by Chaz Darby (4-2) as of the fed's own 17 May 1998 rankings sheet.

name: NIWF Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Davey Rumble (2-0) as of the fed's own 17 May 1998 rankings sheet.

name: NIWF Diamond Championship
epitaph: Held by "Extreme War Machine" Corey Irons (5-0) as of the fed's own 17 May 1998 rankings sheet.

name: NIWF International Championship
epitaph: Held by Axel Schmidt (4-1) as of the fed's own 17 May 1998 rankings sheet.

name: NIWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Napalm (5-0) as of the fed's own 17 May 1998 rankings sheet.

name: NIWF TV Championship
epitaph: Held by The Ferret King (3-5) as of the fed's own 17 May 1998 rankings sheet.

name: NIWF Women's Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in this promotion's own held record when Medusa Rage beat JoAnne Smith in a steel cage on 2 June 2002.

name: NIWF Old School Championship
epitaph: Defended in this promotion's own held record when Desmond Walker's title match with "The Journeyman" Lance Nelson went to a no contest on 27 October 2002; the title's own founding is not staged in any held document.
